_comment: Advisories knowingly accepted for production dependencies. Each entry needs a reason and a review-by date (YYYY-MM-DD); after that date the exception is ignored and CI fails again.

accepted.reason: PostCSS stringify XSS applies when untrusted CSS is processed. PostCSS runs here only at build time on this repository's own stylesheets, never on user-supplied CSS. The bundled copy is only replaced by Next 16.
sourceMappingURL file read needs attacker-controlled CSS comments; PostCSS only processes this repository's own CSS at build time. Fixed upstream only in Next 16.
Incomplete fix of GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q; same exposure (attacker-controlled CSS), not reachable at runtime here. Fixed upstream only in Next 16.
Path traversal via previous-source-map auto-loading needs attacker-controlled CSS; build-time only on own CSS. Fixed upstream only in Next 16.
Cache poisoning of SSG/ISR pages in SELF-HOSTED deployments (moderate). Listed for visibility; re-check if the app is ever self-hosted. Fixed upstream in Next 16.
Cache poisoning in SSG/ISR rendering for self-hosted deployments (moderate). Same reasoning as GHSA-4jqv-mc3x-m676. Fixed upstream in Next 16.
